conviction_note: The bar is the company's own internal Q3 target of $12-14M, down from $16.7M in Q2. The stock has fallen 49% in 20 sessions on a sector and election derisking: the 2026-11-03 Democratic sweep puts the $55B reconciliation drone money at risk. The release turns on whether management keeps its $25M Q4 internal target and the Drone Dominance timing. Supporting that target are a $16.9M Powerus PO, the Upgrade Energy close, and Gauntlet II orders of about 60,000 drones. Pointing the other way, this name sold its last big beat (-5.8% on a 687% growth quarter), and there is no usable option chain. So findings sum to +2.3 while the scaled number is only +0.96 (p_up 54 on a 12% absolute move). The gap is the reaction-history veto and the macro overhang, which the findings alone do not net out.
bar: Company internal target (not formal guidance) of $12-14M Q3 2026 revenue and $25M Q4, from CEO Allan Evans on the Q2 2026 call (transcript: https://www.webull.com/news/15395663464719360, 2026-08-06). The Q2 shareholder letter says Q3 will not follow the growth pattern and Q3 margins will fall from 34.7% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001956955/000168316826006015/umac_ex9901.htm). No sell-side revenue consensus for Q3 could be sourced. Benzinga's Q3 EPS consensus of about -$0.17 is snippet only. The bar is the company target, so sizes on reported-quarter lines are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest: 8.2M shares and 3.5 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement, down from 8.9M on 09-15 (curvedtrading.com via search snippet; the page returned 403). Earlier, 9.4M shares, 18.9% of float and 2.9 days to cover on 2026-08-20 (https://equibles.com/stocks/umac/shortinterest). On about 50-52M shares that is roughly 16-18% of float: a crowded short into a name already down 49% in 20 days and 37% in 5. No skew is available: the chain is unusable (ATM spread 133% of mid, ATM IV 282%). Put/call OI is 0.64, which leans to calls. Realised vol is 93% annualised.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue should land inside management's own $12-14M internal target, a sequential decline from $16.7M in Q2, with gross margin below Q2's 34.7% from introduction costs. The company pre-announced both, so the reported quarter itself carries little surprise; the market expects roughly $13M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-06 bmo) revenue was $16.7M against a ~$9.4M estimate (Benzinga), +687% YoY, and the stock fell 5.83% on the session. Big reported-quarter beats have been sold here.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The company told the market the number, so a print at $12-14M is the expected case. Only a print well outside that range would move the stock on this line.
findings.independence: The Q2 shareholder letter, a separate document, says the same in words (Q3 will not follow the historical pattern; margins decline in Q3, rebound in Q4): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001956955/000168316826006015/umac_ex9901.htm

findings.finding: The Q4 outlook is the line that decides the reaction. Management's internal Q4 target is $25M (vs $12-14M in Q3), and since the August call three items have landed that support it: (1) a $16.9M Powerus purchase order for motors, batteries, cameras and VTX on 2026-10-22; (2) the Upgrade Energy (battery) acquisition, closed 2026-10-19 for 1.79M shares, $1M cash and up to $26M earn-out keyed to more than $10M of revenue; (3) the CEO saying more than 60,000 Drone Dominance drones would be ordered in 2H26, mostly in Q4. A reaffirmed $25M Q4 or a first 2027 framing would land on a stock that has priced a funding scare.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the Q2 call reiterated demand and the Q4 ramp, the stock fell 5.83% on the day but doubled over the next month (247wallst 2026-09-08). On the day, the forward story has paid late, not on the print session.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is at $10.83, against $17.28 on 10-29 and $17.09 on 10-23, after the PO and the acquisition were public. The whole 37% five-day fall is sector and election selling, not company news. If the market were pricing the Q4 ramp it would not be trading at about 1.4x cash ($229.6M at Q2) to market cap (~$560M) on a $25M-a-quarter run rate target. What the market cannot yet see is whether management reaffirms Q4 after the election.
findings.independence: The Upgrade Energy closing is a separate primary document (8-K, 2026-10-23: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1956955/000168316826008046/umac_8k.htm). The $25M Q4 target comes from a third (call transcript: https://www.webull.com/news/15395663464719360). The Gauntlet II order flow, which bears on the same Q4, is filed separately as a proxy.

findings.finding: Democrats won both chambers on 2026-11-03, and defense and drone stocks fell on 11-04 (UMAC -9% in CNBC's tally, Seeking Alpha intraday -17.8%; Red Cat -10.4%, Kratos -12.3%). About $55B of autonomous-warfare money sits in a reconciliation package that Jefferies says a Democratic sweep puts at risk. Analysts will press management on how much of its 2027 demand depends on that money, versus the already-appropriated $1.1B Drone Dominance program.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print happened under a funding shock. The stock trades as a beta-14 drone proxy: -12% on 10-30, -9% on 08-28, and -8% on 10-01 despite positive Pentagon news.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced already: -37% in 5 sessions. What is not priced is management's answer. A soft or hedged 2027 comment would extend the derating; an answer anchored to the funded Drone Dominance program would reverse part of it. The sign is an inference on macro-to-company transmission that the company has not confirmed, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Briefs Finance, 2026-10-28, gives the reconciliation risk from Jefferies and AEI (https://www.briefs.co/?p=28451). CNBC, 2026-11-04, gives the election outcome (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/defense-stocks-slide-on-fear-democrats-will-curb-spending-one-analyst-say-its-a-buying-opportunity.html). Both are proxies, not company documents.

findings.finding: The short is crowded and the stock oversold into the print: 8.2M shares short (~16% of float) and 3.5 days to cover at 2026-09-30, after a 49% fall in 20 sessions and 37% in 5, with call-leaning open interest (P/C 0.64). Any reassurance on Q4 or 2027 meets forced covering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved squeeze on a print. The 57% one-day jump on White House funding talks (Yahoo) shows the upside convexity when the narrative turns.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest data lags by about 8 business days and the latest reading predates the 49% fall, so the short base may have covered or grown. This is a mechanism, not a mispriced fact, and it shrinks any negative reading of the release.
findings.independence: The option book's put/call OI of 0.64 is in the sealed baseline, a separate source.

findings.finding: The balance sheet is not the risk: $229.6M of cash at 2026-06-30 (after $58.2M net from ATM blocks at $30) against a market cap of about $560M at $10.83 on about 52M shares. Breakeven is targeted for end of Q1 2027, so there is no financing need into or out of this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Past raises at deep discounts sold the stock 12-26% (May 2025, July 2025, March 2026). The Q2 ATM blocks at $30 were absorbed.
findings.why_not_priced: Public. It matters only as the absence of the usual small-cap post-print raise. A raise at $10 would be visible as another leg down, and with this much cash it is unlikely. Q3 cash, after the Q3 burn, will show on the new balance sheet.
findings.independence: The 10-Q of 2026-08-06 shows 49,956,505 shares at June 30. This is the same filing family, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: Customer concentration: the largest customer was about 42% of Q2 revenue. Q3 mix will show whether that customer slowed or others took up the slack; a single customer pulling back would explain a Q3 at the low end of $12-14M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved history of a concentration surprise at this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed, so largely priced. Sized net of the other 58% of revenue and of the new Powerus PO, which reduces dependence on one customer in Q4.
findings.independence: 247wallst repeated the 42% figure on 2026-10-30 (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/30/unusual-machines-sinks-12-red-cat-tumbles-10-as-high-beta-drone-stocks-slide-ondas-drops-9-aerovironment-falls-6/). It is the same underlying disclosure.

findings.finding: Gauntlet II results (DIU, mid-Sept 2026): nine FPV makers (Neros, Skycutter, Vector, Swarm, XTEND, Perennial, Hyperscale, ModalAI, Orqa US) to receive orders for about 60,000 drones (about $300M). Reporting says half must be delivered within 2.5 months of contract, a Q4 component pull. Management said over half of the Drone Dominance participants are UMAC customers, but no winner is named as a UMAC customer in these sources.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 8% on 10-01 despite Pentagon autonomous-warfare news. Program news has not reliably moved it.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a proxy: the transmission to UMAC is unconfirmed. Management may quantify Drone Dominance-linked orders on the call, which would turn it from inference into a company number.
findings.independence: Fool, 2026-10-03, lists the winners (https://fool.com/investing/2026/10/03/heres-who-won-the-drone-dominance-gauntlet-2-conte). For the UMAC link, the Q2 letter says 'Over half of the participants are Unusual Machines customers' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001956955/000168316826006015/umac_ex9901.htm).

findings.finding: Auditor change: Salberg & Company was dismissed on 2026-08-12 and Ernst & Young engaged for FY2026, with no disagreements or reportable events. The Q3 10-Q is the first interim under the new auditor's review, which raises the chance of reclassifications or more conservative recognition on acquired-company accounting.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference with no document pointing to a problem; the filing states no disagreements. An upgrade to a Big Four auditor can equally be read as positive, so it is sized near 0.

findings.finding: CEO Allan Evans was granted 5,000,000 warrants (through 8 Consulting LLC) exercisable at $25.00 on 2026-10-05, after the 10-07 shareholder vote (8-K item 5.07). That is about 10% potential dilution, far out of the money at $10.83, and will run through Q4 stock compensation expense.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on a print. Insider sales filings weighed on the stock in August (sweep row).
findings.why_not_priced: Public on Form 4. It can affect a GAAP loss that is wider than expected through stock compensation, which an adjusted-EBITDA-focused release will strip out.
findings.independence: 8-K item 5.07 of 2026-10-07 (shareholder approval) is from the same company filing set.

outside_window.finding: Resale S-3 for the 1,792,012 Upgrade Energy merger shares must be filed within 30 days of the 2026-10-19 close and made effective within about 60 days. No lock-up is disclosed, so a resale overhang of about 3.4% of shares opens from mid-November into January.
Ondas, a drone peer, reports Q3 on 2026-11-12, after this window.

searched_and_found_nothing: A company-specific cause for the -17.8% on 11-04 and the further leg on 11-05: none beyond the election-driven sector sell-off. No UMAC 8-K or press release since 10-23 other than the 11-02 Form D, which records merger shares with $0 sold for cash.
A sell-side Q3 2026 revenue consensus: MarketBeat, Benzinga and Seeking Alpha returned 403 or no period label.
Peer prints since the Q2 call: no Q3 2026 releases found for Red Cat, Kratos or AeroVironment as of today.
Analyst price-target changes in Oct-Nov 2026: none found.
Whether any Gauntlet II winner is a named UMAC customer: not found.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Lightyear/Simply Wall St's '$12-14M Q3 target' quoted as if it were formal guidance
rejected_candidates.detail: Duplicates finding 1, which cites the primary transcript; management called it an internal target, not guidance.

rejected_candidates.candidate: An Asianet item saying a DIU official expects fewer than 200,000 drones ordered by February (production gap)
rejected_candidates.detail: The article's date could not be confirmed from the URL or the snippet, so it is not usable as dated evidence.

baseline_tension: There is no skew and no usable chain. The -49% 20-day run-up has a documented sector and election cause, and the findings lean mildly against it (Q4 orders, cash, crowded short). That cuts against the run-up only modestly, because this name sold its last big beat.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; this name sold its last beat): Q4 guidance finding cut from +2.5 to +2.0, and p_up moved from 55 to 54.

Lesson 7 (positioning): short-interest data predates the fall and may be stale, so the positioning finding was trimmed from +1.5 to +1.2. The negative macro finding was kept small because the short is crowded.
Lesson 5 (proxy smaller): Gauntlet II proxy cut from +0.5 to +0.3, auditor inference from -0.3 to -0.2.
Lesson 9 (segment net of the rest): largest-customer finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3, net of the other 58% of revenue and the new Powerus PO.
Added the CEO warrant grant at -0.2. The fact was found before LESSONS was read but left unfiled in the draft; the core's file-every-sourced-fact rule required it.

Lesson 6: bar sourced to the company's internal target on the transcript; sell-side consensus is unsourced, so the reported-quarter findings stay capped small; nothing moved outside the window beyond the S-3 overhang already there.
